faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions we hear most.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Orders are processed within 1–2 business days and typically arrive within 3–5 business days, depending on your location.

items.question: What is your return policy?
items.answer: You can return unused items in their original packaging within 14 days of delivery for a full refund.

items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept major cards and popular buy-now-pay-later options at checkout, all processed through secure, encrypted providers.

items.question: Can I track my order?
items.answer: Yes. Once your order ships you receive a tracking number, and you can follow its status from the order tracking page at any time.

items.question: Do you support Arabic and English?
items.answer: Absolutely. The entire store is bilingual — switch between Arabic and English at any time, with prices shown in SAR.
